extracted.intended_audience: patent applicants, representatives, and ARIPO/Designated State industrial property offices operating under the Harare Protocol
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural rules, required forms, timelines, and notifications under the ARIPO Harare Protocol for filing, examination, refusals, reconsideration, conversions and grant/registration of patents and utility models.

rubrics_metrics.name: Refusal for non-compliance with prescribed formal requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: The ARIPO Office may refuse the application on grounds of non-compliance with the prescribed formal requirements because the applicant(s) failed to respond to the invitation by the ARIPO Office to correct the application (invitation transmitted on ARIPO Form No. 11).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notification of such refusal uses ARIPO Form No. 14 and must indicate the reasons; if refusal follows a failure to correct within time limits the notification should cite the relevant rule (e.g., Rule 15(3), Instruction 43).

rubrics_metrics.name: Refusal for non-compliance with time limits
rubrics_metrics.description: The ARIPO Office may refuse the application on grounds of non-compliance with the time limit (pursuant to Rule 15bis).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A notification pursuant to Rule 15bis should be issued (ARIPO Form No. 14) and state the expired time limit and date. The applicant has procedural rights to request reconsideration (see related entries).

rubrics_metrics.name: Refusal notwithstanding corrections made by applicant
rubrics_metrics.description: The ARIPO Office may decide to refuse the application on grounds of non-compliance with prescribed formal requirements despite any correction made by the applicant in response to the invitation to correct (invitation transmitted on ARIPO Form No. 11).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Such a refusal must be notified (Form No. 14) and the notification procedure after refusal (reconsideration, onward transmission to designated states) applies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to request reconsideration of refusal for formal non-compliance
rubrics_metrics.description: According to Section 3(4), Rule 15(3) and Instruction 43(1), the applicant may, within 2 months from the date of the notification of refusal on formal grounds, request that the ARIPO Office reconsider the decision by filing ARIPO Form No. 15.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The request to reconsider must be made on ARIPO Form No. 15 and include reasons for reconsideration. If no request is made or the Office refuses notwithstanding the request, further notifications are sent to receiving Offices and designated States (Instruction 43(2)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification routing for refusals on formal grounds (Form No.14)
rubrics_metrics.description: A notification Form No. 14 shall be sent in the first instance to the applicant's representative; if the applicant does not request reconsideration or the Office refuses notwithstanding a request, Form No. 14 shall then be sent to the receiving Office and to the industrial property office of each designated State to which ARIPO Form No.12 was sent, as well as to the applicant's representative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the checkboxes and attachment mechanisms in Form No.14 to indicate which box applies and attach copies as required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to request conversion to national application after final refusal (formal grounds)
rubrics_metrics.description: According to Section 3(8), Rule 19(1) and Instruction 54(1), the applicant may, within 3 months from the date of the notification of the decision refusing the application notwithstanding the applicant's request for reconsideration, request on ARIPO Form No. 23 that the ARIPO application be treated in any designated State as an application according to the national law of that State.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The conversion request is made on Form No.23; ARIPO will then transmit documents to the designated States (see Form No.24 and timing obligations).

rubrics_metrics.name: Form No.15 — Request to reconsider decision refusing on formal requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Form No.15 is used by applicants to request reconsideration of a decision refusing an application on grounds of non-compliance with formal requirements and time limits (Rule 15(3); Instruction 43; Rule 15bis).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form No.15 identifies application type, application number, applicant details and requires the applicant to state reasons for the request to reconsider. Include signature and date; follow Instruction 46 for periods when applicable.

rubrics_metrics.name: ARIPO Office request for information on corresponding foreign applications (Form No.16)
rubrics_metrics.description: Pursuant to Rule 16 and Instructions 45 and 46, the ARIPO Office may request that the applicant furnish, within a specified period, the date and number of foreign applications relating to the same or essentially the same invention and copies of communications, patents, final decisions rejecting/invalidating, or other specified documents relating to those foreign applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form No.16 lists specific documents that may be requested (search/examination communications, granted patents, final rejections or invalidations). The applicant has the right to submit comments on documents furnished pursuant to the request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Declaration of withdrawal / add or reduce designated States (Form No.17)
rubrics_metrics.description: Form No.17 records withdrawal of the application (or patent) or addition/reduction of the number of designated States with effect from a specified date (Rule 17; Instruction 47(1)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form must clearly identify the entry/document and include signatures with typed names; indicate effect date and request marking of records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of non-compliance with substantive requirements and invitation to submit observations/amendments (Form No.18)
rubrics_metrics.description: Pursuant to Rule 18(3) and Instruction 50(2), after considering the conclusions of the search and examination report (Rule 18(2)), the ARIPO Office shall notify the applicant of substantive requirement deficiencies (Section 3(3)) and invite the applicant to submit observations and, where applicable, an amended application within a specified period, together with a request for reconsideration on ARIPO Form No.19.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form No.18 must attach the search and examination report and specify the period for response (see Instruction 50(3)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Request to reconsider decision of substantive non-compliance (Form No.19)
rubrics_metrics.description: Form No.19 is used to request reconsideration where the Office has found substantive requirements not complied with (Rule 18(3); Instructions 50 and 51). Applicants may submit observations and/or an amended application under Form No.19, or request reconsideration of a refusal to grant on substantive grounds.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form No.19 must indicate whether observations and/or amended application are attached, or set out reasons for reconsideration if responding to a decision refusing to grant. Include signatures and dates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grounds for refusal to grant on substantive requirements (Form No.20)
rubrics_metrics.description: The ARIPO Office may refuse to grant a patent on grounds of non-compliance with substantive requirements because the applicant failed to respond to the invitation (Form No.18), or may refuse despite observations/amendments having been submitted, or where other applications for the same invention with the same filing/priority date were filed by the same applicant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form No.20 must indicate which box applies and give reasons. Applicants may, within 2 months of notification, request reconsideration on Form No.19 (Section 3(4) and Instruction 51(3)). If applicant's reconsideration is unsuccessful or no request is made, Form No.20 is forwarded to receiving Offices and designated States per Instruction 51(4).

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to request reconsideration of refusal to grant (timing and form)
rubrics_metrics.description: According to Section 3(4) and Instruction 51(3), the applicant may, within 2 months from the date of notification of a decision refusing to grant, request the ARIPO Office to reconsider the decision by filing ARIPO Form No.19.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If unsuccessful and the decision is final, the applicant may still request conversion to national application as provided elsewhere (Form No.23 within 3 months).

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to request conversion to national application after refusal to grant (Form No.23)
rubrics_metrics.description: According to Section 3(8), Rule 19(1) and Instruction 54(1), within 3 months from the notification of the decision refusing to grant a patent notwithstanding a reconsideration request, the applicant may request on ARIPO Form No.23 that the application be treated in any designated State as an application according to that State's national law.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form No.23 must indicate requested conversion type and specified fees; ARIPO will transmit documents to designated States within 2 weeks (see Form No.24).

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of decision to grant/register (Form No.21) — attachments
rubrics_metrics.description: When the ARIPO Office decides to grant a patent or register a utility model, it may attach a copy of the search and examination report and/or a copy of the application to the notification (Section 3(6)(b); Rule 18(4); Instruction 52).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Form No.21 checkboxes to indicate attachments. The Office requests payment of grant/registration and publication fees within a specified period; designated States have a 6-month window to communicate no-effect (Form No.22).

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment of grant/registration and publication fees after grant notification
rubrics_metrics.description: Upon notification of grant/registration (Form No.21), the ARIPO Office requests the applicant(s) to pay grant/registration and publication fees within the period specified in the notification.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Failure to pay within the specified period may prevent grant/registration; ensure payment and follow-up to enable ARIPO to grant/register under Section 3(7)/Rule 20 and related Instructions (55–57).

rubrics_metrics.name: Designated States’ 6-month communication after grant notification (Form No.22)
rubrics_metrics.description: Before the expiration of 6 months from the date of the grant notification, each designated State may, pursuant to Section 3(6)(a)/Section 3ter(8)(a), make a written communication on ARIPO Form No.22 stating that if a patent is granted it shall have no effect in its territory for reasons indicated in Section 3(6)(a)/Section 3ter(8)(a).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If no communication is made within 6 months and fees are paid, the patent/utility model shall have effect in those designated States which have not made the communication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designated State communication that patent shall have no effect (Form No.22) — grounds and applicant remedy
rubrics_metrics.description: A designated State may communicate that a patent shall have no effect in its territory because (a) the invention is not patentable under Protocol provisions (cite statutory provisions), or (b) under the State's law a patent cannot be registered/granted or has no effect (attach statutory provisions).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: According to Rule 18(5)(b) the applicant may, within 3 months from the date of this notification, request reconsideration through the industrial property office of that designated State.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicant options after designated State no-effect decision (Form No.22A)
rubrics_metrics.description: Form No.22A allows the applicant to (a) accept the designated decision and withdraw the State (attach ARIPO Form 17), (b) request conversion of the application to a national application (attach Form 23), or (c) request the designated State to reconsider its decision based on attached documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicate the chosen option and attach the appropriate forms/documents; include signature and date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designated State acceptance after reconsideration (Form No.22B)
rubrics_metrics.description: Form No.22B is the communication by a designated State to ARIPO that the application has been accepted with respect to that State's territory after reconsideration of the applicant's request (Section 3(6)(d)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form No.22B identifies the application and the designated State and indicates acceptance; include signature and date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conversion between ARIPO application and national/utility model/patent types (Form No.23 & timing)
rubrics_metrics.description: Form No.23 is used to request conversion of an ARIPO patent application into a national application, conversion of an ARIPO patent application into a utility model application (Section 3(9)), or conversion of a utility model application into a patent application (Section 3ter(11)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requests must indicate requested conversion, attach specified fees, identify designated States, and ARIPO shall within 2 weeks from receiving the request transmit the documents required by Rule 19(2) and Instruction 54(2) to the industrial property offices of each designated State specified.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transmittal and notification by ARIPO Office of conversion documents (Form No.24)
rubrics_metrics.description: Form No.24 is used to transmit application/documents to designated State industrial property offices and to notify applicant and designated State of conversion. The transmittal may include copy of Form No.23/38, copy of the application, and other specified documents.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A copy of one of the Forms No.24 transmitted shall also be sent to the applicant's representative, without accompanying documents. Indicate all recipient industrial property offices by name and State.

rubrics_metrics.name: ARIPO patent front page bibliographic data requirements (Form No.25 / INID codes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Form No.25 (ARIPO PATENT front page) lists required bibliographic data fields (INID codes) including Application No., Filing date, Priority, Publication No., Int. Cl., Owner(s), Inventor(s), Date of publication of ARIPO patent, Representative, Effective date of grant, Documents/References cited, Designated Contracting States, Title, Abstract (with most illustrative drawing), and note that description and claims are attached and form integral part.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: INID codes correspond to WIPO Standard ST.9; drawings should be attached if applicable. Additional information or comments may be included in the designated field.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certificate of grant contents (Form No.26)
rubrics_metrics.description: Form No.26 certifies that a patent has been granted and provides the patent number, grantee name and address, grant date, designated Contracting States in which it has effect, filing date, priority date, and invention title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include date and Director General signature; ensure consistency with grant/registration records and designated States.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notification of amendments by applicant(s) after grant/registration communication (Form No.27)
rubrics_metrics.description: Form No.27 acknowledges receipt of ARIPO Form No.22 (communication by Office in respect of grant/registration) and advises that the applicant has submitted the stated amendments or documents to comply with relevant statutory provisions; a copy of the submitted material should be attached.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Form No.27 asks the Office for a timely response to enable further processing. Include applicant details and signature, and specify what was submitted.
